entries.appliesTo: no one — defines "artificial intelligence" for the Mississippi Code

sources.definition: § 1 — 'The term "artificial intelligence" means a machine-based system that can, for a given set of human-defined objectives, make predictions, recommendations or decisions influencing real or virtual environments.'
sources.codification: § 2 — 'Section 1 of this act shall be codified in Chapter 3, Title 1, Mississippi Code of 1972.'
sources.effectiveDate: § 3 — 'This act shall take effect and be in force from and after July 1, 2026.'

flags: definitions-only act: imposes no duty, penalty, or enforcement on any party; category is a forced choice from the fixed vocabulary — coded public-sector because the act's only operative effect is codification of a definition into the Mississippi Code (Title 1, Chapter 3), not an obligation on companies, persons, or schools
definition matches the NIST/OMB 'machine-based system' formulation verbatim in substance
